title: Proof of Terminal Resolution of Hadronic Mass
html: With q = q_0 fixed by the lepton mass ratio (skein mass relation), the hadronic masses are determined without free parameters. By (nucleon Borromean topology), the proton and neutron are Borromean configurations 6_2^3 of three quark vortices bound by Hopf links. Their mass contribution arises entirely from the Skein functional. By (pair Skein mass formula), each color-exchange crossing pair contributes \mathcal{S}_{ab}(q) = (q\mu_a + q^{-1}\mu_b)/(q^{1/2} + q^{-1/2}). The nucleon mass is the sum over its three pairs. By (flavor-dressed mass from substrate split), the proton and neutron formulas m_p = \mathcal{S}_{\mathfrak{u}\mathfrak{u}} + 2\mathcal{S}_{\mathfrak{u}\mathfrak{d}} and m_n = 2\mathcal{S}_{\mathfrak{u}\mathfrak{d}} + \mathcal{S}_{\mathfrak{d}\mathfrak{d}} together with the substrate-derived splitting prop:flavor-split-substrate determine the dressed quark masses \mu_{\mathfrak{u}} \approx 311.10\,\text{MeV} and \mu_{\mathfrak{d}} \approx 312.39\,\text{MeV}. These reproduce the CODATA proton and neutron masses to within a -0.53\% residual on the splitting m_n - m_p (dominated by the dropped O((\Delta m / M_N)^2) correction to prop:flavor-split-substrate). See rem:dressed-quark-numerology-at-q0 for the per-quark numerology and the closure tabulation. \square
